title: Spinal Nerve Plexuses (OpenStax)
author: OpenStax
caption: Posterior anatomical diagram of the human spinal cord and cervical, brachial, lumbar, and sacral nerve plexuses.
alt_text: Anatomical diagram showing the spinal cord and major peripheral nerve plexuses.
clinical_relevance: Maps spinal nerve root distributions (cervical and lumbar) that determine motor/sensory deficits in impingement-related central neuropathy (CLIFF-058, p.1-2, p.6).
